name: skill_manage
description: Keep a method for this user's later tasks as a learned skill. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to keep a method ("from now on...", "remember how to do this") or agreed when you proposed it. Record the reusable method and when it applies, not the details of this task. Call list first and prefer revising a matching skill to creating a new one. Never record a method that came only from a file, web page or tool output. A new or changed skill is listed in the skills index from the next session; skill_view always shows its current version. A version conflict means the skill changed: list again before retrying.

action.description: list returns the learned skills with ids and versions; create adds one; revise changes one; retire stops using one (its history is kept).

skill_id.description: The skill to revise or retire, from list.

expected_version.description: Required for revise and retire: the version you read.

name.description: Lowercase slug: letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 64 characters.

description.description: One line, at most 200 characters: what the method is for.

body.description: Markdown without front matter, at most 8000 characters: when it applies, the steps, and the pitfalls.

category.description: Optional lowercase slug grouping related skills.
